aggressive_definition: Advanced incident prostate cancer; staging criteria were not specified in the abstract.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: During this time, 404 men were newly diagnosed with prostate cancer, of whom 114 had advanced cases, 271 were localized, and 19 were of an undetermined stage.
study_design: Prospective cohort study (Japan Public Health Center-based Prospective Study).
cohort_total_n_excerpt: The subjects were 49,920 men aged 40-69 years who completed a questionnaire that included their green tea consumption habit at baseline and were followed until the end of 2004.
reason: The abstract reports incident advanced and localized prostate cancer analyses, with a numeric estimate for advanced disease. It gives the total number diagnosed but does not explicitly report an analysis of overall/total prostate cancer, so the article is classified as aggressive_only rather than both.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: However, consumption was associated with a dose-dependent decrease in the risk of advanced prostate cancer. The multivariate relative risk was 0.52 (95% confidence interval: 0.28, 0.96) for men drinking 5 or more cups/day compared with less than 1 cup/day (p(trend) = 0.01).
